Commentary.Commentary: The chase is set to begin. Sri Lankan players stride out to the middle. Followed by Janneman Malan and Aiden Markram, who come out to bat for South Africa. Dushmantha Chameera to start the ball.

Right then. Sri Lanka have posted a total of 300 runs. The visitors won't be happy with their bowling effort, but now, the onus will surely be on the batters to chase down the target and get a lead in this series. But will the South African batters rise to the occasion? All we can do is wait and find out. This is a day-night game, so dew could be a factor, which means, batting could get easier. At the same time, if the pitch gets slower, spinners come into play. Let's see what happens. Do join us for the chase on the other side.

The spinners dominated with the ball for the Saffas! The pacers could not trouble the batters in the opening phase of the game. They had no wickets under their belly until Aiden Markram drew first blood. Soon after, Keshav Maharaj got into the attack and left Sri Lanka two more wickets down. At this point, it looked like the visitors would look to make inroads in the match, but it was not to be. They were pushed back by some crucial partnerships in the middle. Maharaj ended his spell with two wickets to his name, also, he was very miserly. Aiden Markram and Tabraiz Shamsi ended with a wicket but the latter leaked way too many runs. It was surely not a day for the pacers. They struggled throughout the game. They could not stem the run flow, until, Rabada snared two wickets in the death overs.

A good show by the top-order for the hosts! This is something that Sri Lanka were looking for and they will be really happy with the effort of their batters. It all started with Avishka Fernando and Minod Bhanuka who gave them a solid start. At the end of Powerplay 1, Sri Lanka were at 50/0. But then came a rough patch, when Fernando remained a spectator at one end and saw his team lose two wickets in quick succession. But the youngster Fernando remained really calm and focused on building partnerships, to take his team to safer shores. He did so brilliantly by putting up two more partnerships with Dhanajaya de Silva and Charith Asalanka. Fernando though could not continue till the end and had to walk back after scoring his 3rd ODI century. Although, Asalanka picked up things after that and came up with a composed knock of 72 runs, which is also his career-best. 90 runs came in the final 10 overs, which helped Sri Lanka to end their innings at 300/9.

Sri Lanka certainly would be the happier side after the first innings. They started brilliantly and they had the upper hand in this game throughout the first innings. South Africa fought hard till the end but could not hunt down the wickets to put the pressure on the hosts and let the opposition score freely and now their batters have the big task of chasing down 300.

OUT! RUN OUT! Two run outs in the last two balls of the innings and that closes out the innings of Sri Lanka. This looked like a carbon copy of the run out on the previous ball. Back of a length, around off, Chamika Karunaratne steps out and bunts this to long on. Again, they look for a couple of runs and this was never a double. Anrich Nortje does well to pick up and throw to Rabada again, who whips the bails off quickly as Akila Dananjaya is short. Given out by the on-field umpire. SRI LANKA END ON 300/9!
Who will walk out next? It is going to be Akila Dananjaya.

OUT! RUN OUT! Easily done. On a length, around off, this is drilled to the long on region. The batters want the second run. Anrich Nortje runs in, collects the ball and throws it to Rabada, who gets the ball and whips the bails off. Dushmantha Chameera is well short.

FOUR BYES! It worked out nicely, in the end, for the Lankans. A length-ball, on the middle and leg pole, Chamika Karunaratne swings but misses. The ball hits the leg pole, but it will not matter as this was a Free Hit. The ball runs away to the fine leg region, where Temba Bavuma runs to his right, slides, and stops the ball. The third umpire has a look and it is seen that Bavuma's foot was in contact with the ropes, when he had the ball in hand. Four byes signalled.

NO BALL! Ahhhh, just the last thing that the Saffas needed here. A fuller-ball, around off, whipped through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. The on-field umpire calls it a no ball as Rabada has overstepped. Free Hit coming up...
A slower short one, around off, Chamika Karunaratne looks to hook this one away but misses.
Who will walk out at number 9? It is going to be Dushmantha Chameera.

OUT! CAUGHT! Similar to the previous delivery, but this time, Charith does not get the required distance on this. Short again, around off, Charith Asalanka again lines up to the play the pull shot, but gets a top edge. This time, the ball only manages to go the left of the keeper, Heinrich Klaasen, who moves that side and makes no mistake. Second one for KG!
Commentary.Howout: c Heinrich Klaasen b Kagiso Rabada

Commentary.Commentary: TOP EDGE AND FOUR! Just the start that Sri Lanka would have wanted to the final over. Rabada hurls across a shortish ball, around off, Charith Asalanka looks to hook this one away but the ball takes the top edge and goes over the keeper and runs away to the ropes.
Full toss, around off, banged to the right of long on for a couple of runs. 15 off the penultimate over! How many will Sri Lanka get off the final over?
Yorker on middle, dug out to the leg side for one.

SIX! A very loose ball this late in the innings. Looked to be above waist height but the umpire does not signal anything. A full toss on the body, Charith Asalanka swivels and pumps this one all the way over fine leg for a biggie.

FOUR! He gets done by the spin there. On a length, on the leg pole, Charith Asalanka whips this towards deep mid-wicket. Kyle Verreynne runs to his left, but overruns, and the ball lands and spins, which deceives him. He slips trying to stop and turn back as the ball goes past him to the ropes.
A full toss on the pads, whipped to square leg for one.
Fullish, on leg, worked to the leg side for one.
Chamika Karunaratne walks in at number 8.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Rabada gets his first wicket. Wanindu Hasaranga is not able to go hard and provide that final push from his side. He tried to force the issue but he just did not get going. A yorker, speared in, around middle and leg, Wanindu Hasaranga moves leg side and looks to dig this one out, but the ball takes the outside edge and crashes into the stumps behind.
FIVE WIDES! A poor delivery from Rabada! Slips in a fuller ball down the leg side, Wanindu Hasaranga leaves it alone and the keeper is not able to stop this as well. The ball races away to the ropes.
Around off, pushed to covers.
Slower, short, around off, Wanindu Hasaranga looks to play the ramp shot but misses.
Short, slower, around off, Charith Asalanka looks to cut it away but the ball takes the edge and finds the keeper on the bounce, who fumbles. They sneak a run.
Full toss outside off, Charith Asalanka swings at this but misses.
Full, on off, jammed out to the off side for one.
WIDE. A slower bouncer on middle, Wanindu Hasaranga just leaves this one alone. Wide signalled.
FOUR! Class. He is in top gear here. Fullish, around off, Charith Asalanka whacks this one over the cover region and gets a boundary.
Slower, short ball outside off, CA looks to slash it away but misses.
A single as this is pushed through mid on.
On the leg pole, flicked to short fine leg for one.

Nicely worked away. On a fullish length, on middle, Charith Asalanka goes back and whips this one through mid-wicket. They come back for the second run quickly. Also, this brings up the fifty for Charith Asalanka. It has been a really good knock from him so far and he will look to end things on a bright note.
A full toss around off, pushed towards mid off for one.
Short ball and outside off. Asalanka leaves it alone.

OUT! RUN OUT! Kagiso Rabada scores a direct hit and Shanaka has to depart. He thought he was in. Also, there were no celebrations from Rabada. Everyone thought Shanaka was safe but that was not the case. Back of a length and on off. Asalanka hangs back and defends it back to the bowler. Shanaka has already taken off for a single, but hears a no from the other end and he turns back to get to safety but he got a little too late. Rabada collects the ball, turns, and hits the wickets at the non-striker's end. The umpire takes it upstairs to confirm. The replays roll in and show that the batsman was well outside the crease. The final decision is out.
The recent recruit of the Bangalore franchise in the Indian T20 League, Wanindu Hasaranga, makes his way out in the middle!

FOUR! What a shot. Asalanka gets some room outside the off stump and he plays it brilliantly. A length ball, outside off. Asalanka hangs back. He hits it from the middle of the bat. The ball goes over the cover region for a boundary.

Is that run out? Good work from KG, regardless. He was very quick to the ball. Oh, well, this is top work by Rabada as the bat is short of the crease, when the bails come off. This will be out and Dasun Shanaka walks back!
Full and down leg. Shanaka gets behind the line of the delivery and looks to flick but the ball takes the pad and goes towards fine leg. A leg bye is taken.
Full and outside off. Asalanka pushes it to cover for a single.
A full-length ball, on the pads. Asalanka stays back and tucks it through mid-wicket. The batters take two runs. This is some good running.
Loopy ball, on off. Shanaka blocks it out watchfully.
Floated and on off. Asalanka blocks it to cover and takes off for a single.
Full and on middle. Shanaka tucks it towards mid on for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Shanaka pushes it to cover.

Big, big stumping opportunity for Heinrich Klaasen but he could not gather the ball. Floated and outside off. Shanaka dances down the track and looks to heave it away but misses. The ball goes towards the keeper, through the gap between the bat and pad. But the keeper could not capitalize on it. The batter is safe.
Loopy ball, around off. Asalanka plays it really late. He guides it towards third man and rotates the strike.
Short and on off. Asalanka hangs back and pulls it to deep square leg for another single. Nortje is finding it difficult to find the right line and length.
Back of a length and on off. Shanka is surprised by the pace off it. He pulls it awkwardly towards square leg and gets a single.

Yorker length delivery, on off. Shanaka digs it out solidly to the mid off region. He is watching the ball as Charith Asalanka is already halfway down the track. Rassie van der Dussen runs across to his right from extra cover and that is where Shanaka is watching. Rassie has a shy at the non-striker's end on the run but misses by a big margin. Asalanka was not even in the picture.
Nortje serves a full toss, on the bodyline. Asalanka stays back and whips it to deep square leg for a single.
Short ball and on off. Asalanka sways away from the line of the delivery.
Full toss and on off. Asalanka stays back and pushes it to cover.

FOUR! Shanaka hits it really hard and gets the reward. Fullish and outside off. Shanaka plays it late and cuts it through point. The ball races away to the boundary. This one was all about sheer timing.
On the pads. Shanaka tucks it to square leg.
Floated full and outside off. Asalanka pushes it to point for a run.
Short and outside off. Asalanka stays back and cuts it through point for a couple.
Who will walk out next? It is going to be Dasun Shanaka.

OUT! CAUGHT! Finally. Finally, the South Africans find a way to stop Fernando. He started off slow, got to his ton, then decided to unleash the beast, but Shamsi gets the better of him. Tabraiz serves a googly, around off, Avishka Fernando skips down the track and looks for the big slog across the line. Fails to read the delivery and the outside edge is induced. The ball lobs high in the air towards the point region, where Andile Phehlukwayo takes a dolly. As Fernando is going back, Tabraiz Shamsi walks up to him and taps his shoulder, appreciating the knock played by the youngster. Great sportsmanship!
Commentary.Howout: c Andile Phehlukwayo b Tabraiz Shamsi

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Well played by Fernando. Fuller, floated around off, Avishka Fernando gets low and slog-sweeps it to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Full and on leg, AF whips this to deep mid-wicket for for one.
Slower in pace, outside off, Fernando looks to slap it away but only manages to chop it to the off side.
Another full toss, Avishka Fernando whips this one to deep square leg and a brace is taken.

FOUR! Just over Temba Bavuma at mid off and Fernando is on the charge. A back-of-a-length delivery, around middle and leg, Avishka Fernando moves to the leg side and flat-bats it towards mid off. Bavuma leaps, gets his fingertips on this, but is not able to stop the ball as it races away to the ropes.
A low full toss, on leg, this is whipped wide of the man at long on and they come back for the second.
FOUR! Avishka Fernando is freeing his arms now. Fuller, outside off, this is lofted over the cover region and he gets another boundary.
Two more! A length ball, on off. Asalanka drills it past mid on. The batters pick two.
A full-length ball, on off. Asalanka lifts it over covers. The batters pick two before the fielder in the deep cuts it out.
A length ball, on the pads. Fernando tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, on off. Asalanka defends it to cover for a single.
Full and outside off. Asalanka looks to chase it but misses.

HUNDRED FOR FERNANDO! A slower, short ball, on off. Fernando stays back and pulls it towards square leg. He takes off for a single and throws his fist in the air. He gets his 3rd century in ODIs. This has been some good batting by the youngster. He deserves all the applause for his efforts.
Time for Powerplay 3! Now, a maximum of 5 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle until the end of the innings.
Around off, cut straight to point.

Around off on a length, Charith Asalanka guides this one past point. The fielder at third man runs to his left and stops the ball, but a couple of runs are taken. Ohhh, it looks like Charith Asalanka did not finish his first run completely, as his bat was short of the crease. So, it will just be a single run.
A touch short, around off, Charith slams this one back to Anrich.
Good-length on middle, tapped to the leg side.
Short, on middle, pulled to the right of deep square leg for a couple of runs.

Length on off, Avishka Fernando taps this to point. They take off for the run as the man there runs forward, collects the ball and has a shy at the striker's end, but misses. Had he hit, it would have been close.
Length on the pads, clipped to square leg for one.
Around off, slower again, guided to third man for one.
Shortish, outside off, CA looks to slash it away but misses.
Around off, pushed through mid on for one.
WIDE. Slipped down the leg side, the flick is missed. Wided.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Fernando and he moves to 96 now! He is getting closer and closer to his ton. Back of a length, slower one, outside off, slapped past point. Anrich Nortje at third man runs to his right in the deep, slides and pushes the ball back. The batsmen take a couple. Now, the umpire wants to have this checked. Replay shows that when Nortje pushed the ball back, his foot was touching the ropes. Boundary signalled.

FOUR! Beautiful. Fernando picked the slower one and smashed it over extra cover. On a fullish length, outside off, Avishka Fernando gets low, waits for the ball to arrive, and then pumps this one over extra cover. He moves to 92!
On off, on a length, punched through covers for one.
The dark clouds are back and hovering around the stadium. Hope the rain gods pass by without putting any halt to the cricket.
Closer to the off pole, on a length, guided through backward point for a couple of runs.
This is played towards square leg for one.
Short of a length, around off, Avishka Fernando goes back and just taps this one through point. The man in the deep runs in, slides and stops the ball. Saves a run for his side.
Short, on the body, pulled to fine leg and a run is taken.
Anrich Nortje comes back into the attack.
On middle, dropped to the leg side.
Leg bye. On a length, on the pads, Charith Asalanka looks to flick this one to the leg side but misses as the ball takes the pad and goes to the leg side. The batters pick up a leg bye.
Shortish, around off, Charith Asalanka goes back and just plays the ramp shot over the keeper. The fielder at third man runs to his left and stops the ball. A brace.
Length on off, tapped to point.
Around off, on a length, AF looks to flick but the ball takes the leading edge and goes through covers for one.
FOUR! Avishka Fernando is turning it up here. On a length, around middle and leg, Avishka Fernando picks it up nicely and works this to the deep square leg fence.
Around off, on a length, kept out.
Outside off, cut to point.
On the pads, whipped to fine leg for one.

SIX! What a shot. A massive stroke. Kyle Verreynne has a chance of taking this catch, but there was not enough room for him to play with. Floated, fuller around off, Avishka Fernando whips this one to the deep mid-wicket region. Kyle goes back, hops to try and take the catch, but the ball does not stick as he, along with the ball, fall after the ropes.
Flatter around off again, this time, CA goes back and pushes this through covers for one.
Flatter, around off, tapped through square leg for one.
Fuller on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
A length ball, on off. Asalanka pushes it to cover.
On a length, outside off. Asalanka guides it towards third man. The batters take two. Some good effort in the deep by the fielder to save a boundary.
Short and on off. Fernando hangs back and pulls it through square leg for a single.
Full and outside off. Fernando guides it towards third man.
SIX! All the way. This was such a good-looking shot by Fernando. A full-length ball, on off. Fernando hangs back and smokes it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum. He moves to 68.
A length ball, on off. Fernando plays it back to the bowler.
Floated and on off. Asalanka punches it past the diving fielder at point. The batters only get two this time.
FOUR! This is the second boundary for the left-hander. Short and outside off. Asalanka stays back and cuts it through point. The ball ends up in the boundary.
On off, Asalanka defends it back to the bowler.
Full and outside off. Asalanka guides it towards third man. The batters take two comfortably.
Almost a helicopter shot by Fernando. Tossed up and on off. Fernando skips down the track and whips it across the line towards long on. They take one.
Floated full and outside off. Asalanka prods to the pitch of the ball and pushes it to cover for a single.
Change. Aiden Markram is back into the attack.
A length ball, on the pads. Asalanka stays inside the crease and clips it to mid-wicket for another run. Rabada gave away only 4 runs in the over.
Short of a good length and on off. Fernando hangs back and tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, around off. Asalanka stays back and pulls it to deep square leg. The batters cross.
Rabada bangs in a short ball, on off. Asalanka sways away from the line of the delivery.
On a length, around off. Asalanka defends it to cover watchfully.
A length ball, on off. Fernando stays back and steers it towards third man. They take one.
FOUR! A much-needed boundary for Sri Lanka. Short and outside off. Asalanka hangs back and guides it behind point. The ball races away to the boundary.
Keshav Maharaj is done for the day with the ball. Who will replace him? It is the speedster, Kagiso Rabada (3-0-22-0) who comes back on!
Loopy ball, full and outside off. Asalanka works it towards point.
Touch short, outside off. Asalanka cuts it to point but straight to the fielder.
In the air..safe! Floated full and on off. Fernando makes room and lifts it over mid off. The ball meets the fielder at long off on a bounce. The batters take a single.
Full and on middle. Asalanka prods and sweeps it through square leg for a run this time.
Short and outside off. Asalanka looks to go after it but misses.
Full and on off. Asalanka flicks it to square leg for another single. Maharaj has been brilliant with the ball in this innings, as he finished with figures of 10-1-30-2!
On off, Fernando pushes it to cover for a single.
Darted on the pads. Asalanka tucks it to square leg for a single.

OUT! STUMPED! Maharaj is already into his last over and he provides with yet another breakthrough. He gets his second wicket of the game. The hosts wanted this pair to stick around for long but that was not the case. Loopy ball, outside off. The ball turns away off the pitch. Dhananjaya de Silva takes a long stride forward and looks to sweep it away but misses. Heinrich Klaasen collects the ball and was quick enough to clip the bails. He is off to celebrate, as he thinks that he has got his man here. The umpire takes it upstairs to confirm. They check for everything. First, the inside edge is checked. Nothing on the UltraEdge as it shows a flat line as the ball passes the bat. Then, they check for the stumping. Now, from the side angle, it seems like the foot is inside the crease. Now, they go for the back angle, that is the stumps camera. Here, we can see that the foot is on the line when the bails are whipped off. After what seems like an eternity, OUT comes on the giant screen. This was taking an age to come and eventually, it has come in favour of the Saffas. The 89-run stand is broken.
Commentary.Howout: st Heinrich Klaasen b Keshav Maharaj

Commentary.Commentary: Charith Asalanka is the new man in!
Floated full and on off. De Silva defends it out watchfully.
Flatter and around off. Fernando goes back and pushes it through cover for a run.

Is Dhananjaya de Silva stumped here? The South Africans seem confident as the third umpire will have a look at this. Replays show that de Silva did not get his foot inside the crease, when the bails were whipped off. The big screen reads OUT!
Nicely done. Flatter, on off, Dhananjaya de Silva taps this one past short third man and comes back for the second
Down the leg side, Avishka Fernando gets low and sweeps this to deep square leg. One run.
A touch short, outside off, guided to short third man for a run.
On the pads, clipped to short fine leg.

FOUR! That's a brilliant hit. Not an easy shot to play. A googly, fuller, outside off, Dhananjaya de Silva opens up the face of the blade and lofts this one over covers. Boundary. This should release some pressure.
WIDE. Shamsi bowls this flatter and down the leg side, left alone.
Avishka Fernando goes back and flicks this past square leg for one.

Dhananjaya de Silva looking to break the shackles but he does not quite time this. This is bowled around off, Dhananjaya de Silva gets low and slog sweeps towards deep mid-wicket. Not timed well so it lands short of the ropes. A couple.
A quick single as this is tapped to the point region.
On the pads, milked to the long on region and the strike is rotated.
Around off and middle, pushed back to Maharaj.
Avishka Fernando skips down the track and bangs this to the long off fielder for a run.
A touch short, outside off, slapped past the diving point fielder and a couple of runs are taken.
Around off, flatter again, de Silva goes back and chops this one to the backward point fielder. Just one from the over!
On off, pushed back to Tabraiz.

Again, flatter, around off, spins back in and Dhananjaya de Silva goes back and looks to force this one through the point region, but gets an underedge, which bounces past the sticks, and the keeper collects this on the bounce.
Around middle, shortish, Dhananjaya de Silva looks to reverse sweep but he only manages an underedge back onto the pad.

Around off and middle, tapped to the leg side for a single. Also, this brings up the 50 for Avishka Fernando! He has taken his time but he has played very well. This is his first 50 against South Africa and he will want to turn this to a big score!
Shortish, on middle, spins in, Fernando goes back and taps this back to Shamsi.
On middle, worked to the long off region for one.
Avishka Fernando punches this one back to Maharaj.
Drags this one short, around off, pulled over the mid on region and the ball lands safe. One run.
Flatter on middle, pushed to the right of the bowler, where Maharaj moves that side and stops the ball.
Flatter, outside off, the ball stays a touch low as de Silva goes back and looks to cut it late, but misses.
Loopy, around off, it turns away, de Silva pushes it, with the turn, towards point.
On the pads, flicked straight to the short fine leg fielder.
Around off, shortish, pushed to the long off region for one.
Played to the mid-wicket fielder this time.
Quicker and on leg, Dhananjaya de Silva goes back and looks to defend but misses and gets hit on the pad. An appeal but turned down.
Pushed to mid on this time.
On middle, tucked to mid-wicket for one.
Outside off. Fernando cuts it through point for a single.

Flighted and on off. Fernando tucks it to the left of mid on. He ventures out looking for a run, but he sends his partner back on seeing the ball is close to the fielder. The man there puts in a dive to his left and throws it to Maharaj at the non-striker's end. If the ball had hit the wickets, de Silva could've been in trouble.
Loopy ball, on off. Fernando blocks it out.
Tossed up, on off. Fernando goes back and pushes it to cover.
On off, kept out.
Around middle and leg, floated. Fernando makes room and pushes it to cover for a couple.
Floated, down leg. Dhananjaya de Silva looks to flick it away but misses. The ball goes towards short fine leg off the pads. At the moment, Sri Lanka are growing nicely.
Looped up, on off. This one turns in. Fernando goes back and flicks it to square leg for a run.
Full and on off. Fernando defends it back to the bowler.
Floated, on the pads. Dhananjaya de Silva stays back and tucks it to square leg for a run.
Flatter and on off. Fernando pushes it to mid off. They take one.
Floated around off. Spinning in. Fernando goes back and defends it out.
On off, pushed back to Maharaj.
Floated, around off, this is swept to the deep square leg fielder for a single. Also, brings up the 50-run stand between Avishka Fernando and Dhananjaya de Silva!
On off, quicker, pushed back to the bowler.
Around off, pushed through covers for one.
That is defended solidly off the front foot.
Touch short and outside off. Fernando pushes it to cover for a single.

We are ready to continue with the action now. No overs have been lost, so far. The South African players come out and spread out on the field. Avishka Fernando and Dhananjaya de Silva follow them out. Keshav Maharaj to bowl now.
Update 4.17 pm local (10.47 am GMT) - The shower was not too heavy and it looks like the covers are coming off as well. If there are no further delays, we should be ready for the action soon enough.

Update 4.10 pm local (10.40 am GMT) - Uh oh! Rain was always on the cards and it has started raining down now. It was a slight drizzle but it has gotten heavier and hence, the umpires tell the players to walk off. The covers come on as well. Not a sight we like looking at, but, there is not much that we can do right now, but wait. Let's hope that this is a short delay and we are back with the action soon. Stay tuned.
Short and on middle. De Silva pulls it towards short fine leg. He did not get the connection he was looking for.
DROPPED! Floated, on middle and leg. De Silva chips it to the right of the bowler. Shamsi dives to his right but he could not collect it cleanly. He is not happy about it.
On off, de Silva works it towards mid on.

FOUR! Over the short extra cover fielder. Looped up, outside off. Dhananjaya de Silva stays back and lifts it over Aiden Markram at short extra cover. Markman leaps high but the ball goes over him and ends up in the boundary.
On the pads. Dhananjaya de Silva tucks it to fine leg.

FOUR! Dhananjaya de Silva hits this one nicely. Short and on off. The ball spins away. Dhananjaya de Silva goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket. The ball races away to the boundary. Also, 100 is up for Sri Lanka.
A length ball, on off. This one is close to the body. Dhananjaya de Silva stays inside the crease and guides it towards third man for a single.
A length ball, on off. Dhananjaya de Silva pushes it to mid off.
Full and around off. Fernando now hangs back. He opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for another single.
Full length and outside off. Dhananjaya de Silva hangs back and steers it towards third man for a run.
A length ball, on off. The ball nips in off the pitch. Dhananjaya de Silva blocks it out solidly.
On a length, outside off. Fernando stays back and guides it towards third man. They take one.
WIDE! Back of a length and outside off. Fernando leaves it alone. The umpire signals a wide as the ball goes over Fernando's head.
Tossed up, on off. Dhananjaya de Silva blocks it out.
Loopy ball, on off. Fernando pushes it to the off side for a single.
FOUR! THUMPED! Floated full and on off. Fernando drills it past mid off. The ball races away to the boundary.
Full and outside off. Fernando looks to push it to the off side but only manages to get an underedge.
Flatter, around off, spinning in, AF goes back and taps this to point.
Floats it up, lands it outside off, Avishka Fernando looks to drive but the ball spins in, takes the inside edge, hits the pad and rolls next to the deck.
Good-length ball, around off, played towards mid off.
This is defended to the leg side by de Silva.
FOUR! SHOT! This was begging to be hit and de Silva obliges. Short and wide outside off, slapped behind point and the ball speeds away to the ropes.
Fullish this time, in the fourth stump channel, driven nicely to deep covers for one.
Around off, pushed to point.
Good-length ball on middle, tucked straight to the short mid-wicket man.
6 off Shamsi's first over! Fullish outside off, drilled to long off, where the fielder at long on runs to his left and stops the ball well. A couple of runs.
On middle, worked to the leg side for a run.
Tosses this one up, lands it around off, Dhananjaya de Silva looks to loft this over mid off, but fails to time it well. Luckily, it goes over the man there and lands safe. One run.
Fuller, outside off, Dhananjaya de Silva guides this one past point for a couple of runs.
Fullish ball, on off, de Silva digs this one out to the leg side.
Quicker, fuller, outside off, Dhananjaya de Silva looks to work this to the off side, but the ball sneaks underneath the bat, to the keeper.
Tabraiz Shamsi comes into the attack now. He replaces Aiden Markram.
A short ball, outside off, takes a while to come to the batter, who hops and slashes this behind point. A single.
Back of a length, outside off, cut away through point for one.
Outside off, pushed away to the point fielder.
WIDE. Slipped down the leg side, easily left alone by Andile. Wided.
Around middle, slightly quicker, Fernando closes the face of his bat early and the outside edge is induced. But, the ball lands safely near covers.
Around off, guided past the short third man fielder for a single.
FOUR! Poor ball to start off with by Andile Phehlukwayo! Strays this one the pads, on a length, this is easily clipped away to the fine leg region for a boundary.

DRINKS! The Sri Lankan openers started well, the hosts were clearly on top. But then came two wickets in quick succession to ruin all the hard work. It was the spinners for South Africa who found the two breakthroughs. The visitors will be hoping to snare a couple more wickets, to sink the opposition ship. Also, a bowling change for South Africa. Andile Phehlukwayo comes into the attack now.
Shortish on middle, knocked to the long on region for a run.
On the pads, worked to the leg side.
Shortish, on the pads, nudged to the square leg fielder.
Floats it up nicely on off, de Silva keeps this one out calmly.
On middle again, flicked to deep square leg for one.
Slides it away from the right-hander, around off, Avishka Fernando looks to push but the ball takes the outside edge and goes to the short third man fielder on the bounce.
Quicker and flatter on middle, knocked to the leg side.
Looped up, on off. Dhananjaya de Silva skips down the track and looks to flick it away. The ball takes the leading edge and goes back to the bowler. But it meets Maharaj on a bounce.
Floated full and on off. Dhananjaya de Silva comes down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
Full and on off. Dhananjaya de Silva drives it to cover.
On the pads. Fernando clips it towards square leg for a single.
WIDE! Loopy ball, down leg. Fernando stays back and looks to sweep it away but misses. Wide called.
Flighted full and on off. Fernando prods and blocks it solidly.
Flatter and on off. Fernando defends it to cover.
On off, Dhananjaya de Silva rather than being innovative again, blocks it out.
Tossed up, down leg. De Silva moves across and scoops it over the keeper's head. The fielder comes running in to his right and cuts it off in time. The batters take two.
Full and on off. De Silva sweeps it towards fine leg for a couple.
Play and a miss! Looped up, outside off. De Silva looks to punch it to the off side but misses.
Tossed up, on off. De Silva works it to the right of the bowler.
Flatter and on the pads. Fernando tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
A loud appeal for LBW but turned down. Loopy ball, around middle and leg. De Silva looks to defend it out but misses and gets rapped on the pads. Maharaj and company appeal but the umpire says no.
Flighted full and on off. Dhananjaya de Silva defends it onto the pitch.
On off, Fernando punches it through cover for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one falls for Sri Lanka, as Rajapaksa walks back for a 3-ball duck. This time, it is Maharaj who provides the breakthrough. Don't really know why you would want to play such a stroke on your third ball. Loopy ball, full and on off. Rajapaksa skips down the track and whips it across the line. The ball goes high in the air towards deep mid-wicket. Kyle Verreynne comes running in, to his right and takes a brilliant catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Kyle Verreynne b Keshav Maharaj

Commentary.Commentary: A short stay by Bhanuka Rajapaksa comes to an end. Dhananjaya de Silva walks out, replacing him.
Around middle and off, floated. Rajapaksa blocks it out watchfully.
A hint of turn. Flatter and outside off. Fernando pushes it through covers. The batters take one.
Full and on off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa prods and defends it onto the pitch. A good over by Markram.

OUT! TIMBER! Aiden Markram gets the first breakthrough. Loopy ball, around off. The ball turns in a bit. Bhanuka gets low and looks to slog-sweep it away but misses. The ball goes through the gap between bat and pad to shatter the stumps. Bhanuka is really disappointed with himself, as he walks back for 27. He could've hung in there. The visitors will look to build on this now.
Floated full and on middle. Fernando clips it to the leg side for a single.
Who walks out? It is Bhanuka Rajapaksa!
Full and on off. Bhanuka pushes it towards mid off for a run.
Floated, full and outside off. Bhanuka stays back and pushes it to cover.
Darted on the pads. Fernando stays back and tucks it to square leg. The batters cross.
That is defended solidly off the front foot.
Around middle and leg, floated, this is worked past mid-wicket for one.
On middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
Floated, landing fuller outside off, Minod Bhanuka looks to poke at this, but gets beaten as the ball spins away slightly.
Flatter around off, pushed back to Maharaj.
Loopy ball, on off. Bhanuka reverse-sweeps it through backward point and gets a couple of runs.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle until the end of the 40th over.
A single to end the over and 50 up for Sri Lanka too at the end of Powerplay 1! Around off, fuller, worked to long off for one.
Closer to off, shortish, tapped to the left of point for a quick single.
Fuller, outside off, hit hard to the mid off fielder.
Again, fuller and on leg, this is nudged through mid-wicket for one.
Aiden Markram comes into the attack now.
Quicker, fuller, on the pads, whipped straight to the man at square leg.
Aiden Markram starts his spell with a full ball on the pads, Aviskha tucks this through square leg for one.
Darted on the pad, Avishka Fernando turns this behind square leg and retains the strike for the next over with a run.
On middle, eased to long on for a single.
Floated, fuller outside off, driven straight to the cover fielder.
Around off, pushed to mid on.
Flatter, around off, Minod keeps this one out.
On middle, Avishka Fernando comes down and pushes this through mid off for one.

In the air...safe! Had there been a fielder there, this would have been the first wicket. A short ball, around off, comes on quickly as Minod Bhanuka miscues the pull. The ball goes high in the air towards deep square leg and lands safe. A couple.
Fullish ball, on middle and leg, Minod clips it, but only finds the square leg fielder.
Short of a length, around off, tapped to point.
This is the 10th dot ball on the trot. South Africa doing well to steady things in this phase. A boucer this time, on middle, Bhanuka watches it go over him to the keeper.
Around middle, dabbed to the leg side.
On a length, around off, Minod Bhanuka blocks it out.
Maiden for Maharaj! On middle, fuller, defended out to the leg side.
On middle, swept to the short fine leg fielder.
Floated, down leg, Avishka Fernando looks to flick but misses and the ball brushes the pad and goes to the keeper.
Darted again on the pads, this is nudged to the leg side.
Floated, fuller around middle, Avishka Fernando presses forward and keeps it out.
Keshav Maharaj comes into the attack now.
Maharaj starts with a flatter ball, on the pads, easily dabbed down by Fernando.
So, the second, fourth, and last ball of the over have the same recipe. Another bounce by Nortje, Minod wants nothing to do with this and he sits under this one.
FOUR! SHOT! Not a great delivery from Anrich Nortje and he has been punished. A full toss, outside off, this is carved through covers for a boundary.
An action replay of the second ball of this over. Another bouncer, Minod ducks under this one again.
Around off, defended out by Bhanuka.
Nortje hurls across a bouncer, around middle, Minod just sits under this one.
Good-length ball on off, this is tapped to the right of mid on for an easy run.
On a length, around off, Minod Bhanuka tries to feel for it but he gets beaten.
Fuller in length, outside off, played past point for one more.
Outside off, dabbed past short third man for a run.
FOUR! Bhanuka gets the second boundary of the over. Slightly short and on off. Bhanuka hangs back and pulls it past mid on. The ball ends up in the boundary.
Rabada comes around the wickets now. He serves a good-length ball, on off. Bhanuka defends it out.
FOUR! This time Bhanuka gets in on the act. Short and outside off. Bhanuka hangs back and punches it through point. The ball goes through the gap and into the boundary.
A length ball, on off. Fernando blocks it out.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Back-to-back boundaries. A good-length ball, outside off. Fernando stays back and cuts it through point for a boundary.

FOUR LEG BYES! On a length, this one comes in from outside off. Fernando looks to flick it away but misses. He gets rapped on his pads. Nortje appeals but the umpire says no. The fielder throws the ball at the non-striker's end, but there was no one behind the stumps. The ball ends up in the boundary. Overthrows.
A length ball, on the pads. Bhanuka stays back and tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
On off, Bhanuka defends it back to the bowler.
Tap and run! A length ball, on off. Fernando works it towards cover and takes off for a quick single. The fielder collects the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end. But his effort goes wide.
On a length, outside off. Fernando guides it towards third man for a single. 9 runs coming off the over.
Back of a length and on off. Fernando defends it out watchfully.
A touch fuller, on off. Fernando blocks it out solidly.
FOUR! Two in a row! This one is much better. Nicely played. On a length, around off. Fernando hangs back and punches it through cover. The ball races away to the boundary.
FOUR! Fernando gets the first boundary of the innings. A length ball, on off. Fernando played it a little early. He lifts it over mid-wicket and the ball races away to the boundary.
A length ball, on off. Fernando defends it back to the bowler.
A length ball, around leg, moving away. Bhanuka stays back and pulls it to deep square leg. They take two.
Anrich bangs in a short ball, on middle. Bhanuka ducks under it.
On a length and on middle. Bhanuka keeps it out.

A stray dog has entered the playing area and Kagiso Rabada tries hard to chase after it, but he never manages to catch up. In the end, the dog decides that he has had his fun and he just goes out of the playing area. And we continue...
A length ball, on the pads. Bhanuka stays back and tucks it through square leg. The batters take a couple.
A touch fuller, on off. Bhanuka pushes it towards mid on.
A length ball, on off. Bhanuka defends it to backward point.

Good-length ball and on off. Fernando looks to flick it away but the outer half takes it to cover. Bavuma collects the ball and wanted to throw it to the keeper, but ends up hitting Fernando who was standing inside the crease. Bavuma apologizes straightaway.

Temba Bavuma fires a stray throw towards the keeper, but he only hits Avishka Fernando around his rib region. The physio comes out and has a look at him. The magic spray is applied and he looks good to continue. Also, it will be Anrich Nortje to bowl from the other end!
A length ball, outside off. This one nips in a bit. Fernando prods and defends it to cover.
Rabada fires in a length ball, on off. Fernando blocks it out watchfully.
Good length and outside off. Fernando leaves it alone.
On a length, around off. Fernando blocks it out solidly.
A length ball, on off. Fernando stays back and drills it to the right of mid off. The fielder there dives to his right and makes a half stop. Fernando gets off the mark with a couple.

NO BALL! Not a good start for Rabada. He serves a good-length ball, outside off. The ball nips away as Avishka Fernando leaves it. The umpire signals a no ball, as the bowler oversteps. Free Hit to follow.

Right then. Done with all the pre-match formalities as the action is about to get underway. The South African players are in a huddle and skipper, Temba Bavuma is imparting some final words of wisdom, before they spread out on the field. The openers for Sri Lanka, Avishka Fernando and Minod Bhanuka make their way out into the middle. As expected, Kagiso Rabada will make use of the new ball. Here he comes, speeding in...
Time for the national anthems now. First, it will be South Africa's, followed by Sri Lanka's.
Temba Bavuma, the South African skipper, is up for a chat. He says, they were also looking to bat first. But they don’t have that option now and would look to do well with the ball.

Dasun Shanaka, the Sri Lankan skipper, is up for a chat. He says, they will opt to bat first. Adds he is very happy to get runs on the board. Mentions the preparations have been really well, as a local tournament just got over a while back and the boys are ready for the series.

PITCH REPORT - This pitch looks very good but when you move closer, there is some moisture on the deck and the ball will grip early on. The batters can still play with freedom, but they will have to work slightly hard for the same.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Aiden Markram, Janneman Malan, Temba Bavuma (C), Rassie van der Dussen, Kyle Verreynne, Heinrich Klaasen (WK), Andile Phehlukwayo, Keshav Maharaj, Kagiso Rabada, Anrich Nortje, Tabraiz Shamsi.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Avishka Fernando, Minod Bhanuka (WK), Bhanuka Rajapaksa, Dhananjaya de Silva, Charith Asalanka, Dasun Shanaka (C), Wanindu Hasaranga, Chamika Karunaratne, Dushmantha Chameera, Akila Dananjaya, Praveen Jayawickrama.
TOSS - We are all in readiness for the flip of the coin. Up it goes and falls in the favour of the hosts. SRI LANKA WILL BAT FIRST!

WEATHER - There were some scares earlier as the weather in Colombo was slightly iffy with grey clouds hovering around, but, for now, it looks like the sun is out and we will have the toss at the designated time.

Hello and a warm welcome to all! It's time for the first ODI between Sri Lanka and South Africa. Both the teams are placed 11th and 10th in the ODI Super League points table and would look to consolidate and use this series as a ladder to move up the table. Sri Lanka have been in a transitional phase and would be eager to get back to winning ways and climb up in the points table. Whereas, South Africa will be eyeing to win this series after a 1-1 drawn ODI series against Ireland. Who will come out on top? We shall find out soon, as the toss is not far away.
